json_schema.description: A defect was found in work that is already CLOSED. Closes are final and the log is monotone, so this never mutates the original result — it opens a NEW contract, linked to the closed one by the event's follows_event_id column (not a payload field: a link the database can enforce as a foreign key is worth more than one it cannot). Its own close is a goal_closed, exactly as for the goal it follows. re_engagement selects the workflow-defined policy: re-engage the original agent with the miss pointed out, or discard and redo on a stronger model. NOT spillable (contract event).

re_engagement.description: re_engage_original | discard_and_redo. Constrained in prose rather than by an `enum`, because this repo's validator implements a deliberate subset of JSON Schema and refuses a schema it cannot enforce — a seed carrying `enum` would fail EVERY append of this type at runtime, not just a bad one. The engine is what rejects an unknown value.
